attempts.summary: Configured node1 to serve the inventory application via Apache httpd on TCP 8181 while SELinux stayed in Enforcing mode, by relabeling the port's SELinux type from intermapper_port_t to http_port_t (semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181) rather than lowering MAC enforcement. Verified the fix was necessary by first reproducing an AVC name_bind denial, then confirming the app serves HTTP 200 in enforcing mode. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/enforcing/service state, restarted node1 with shutdown -r now, confirmed a new boot_id and reset uptime after reconnecting, and verified enforcing mode, httpd, the port policy, and the inventory app all recovered post-restart with no new AVC denials.
